profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Prime Tech Lockheed Martin | C#, C++, Python
profile.summary: Software engineer delivering cross-platform control systems, hardware integrations, and secure deployments for mission-critical government programs. Known for quickly adapting to new technologies and programming languages while managing multiple high-priority projects in parallel. Experienced in leading small teams, reviewing code, and guiding systems from design through on-site testing and hardening. Skilled across C#, C++, Python, Bash, Angular, ASP.NET Core, Qt, GNU Radio, and other tools spanning desktop, web, and embedded development.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Oversee design, development, and deployment of cross-platform control systems, hardware integrations, and secure solutions for mission-critical government programs. Frequently manage multiple projects in parallel, quickly adapting to new technologies and languages to meet evolving requirements. Lead a small engineering team, set priorities, review code, and support on-site testing and system hardening.

Highlighted Projects:

OMNET – Developed a Qt-based client/server platform controlling 6+ EW/RF assets via TCP/UDP with Protobuf. Integrated ArcGIS Runtime SDK for mapping, pulling GPS/compass data for location/heading, and coordinating SDRs and RF amplifiers for EW signal operations.

APR-48 Bus Controller Modernization – Rebuilt a legacy Java MIL-STD-1553 controller in .NET 6 + Angular with USB DDC and Ethernet ALTA support, direct serial read/write, and published API documentation.

Waveform Tuner – Automated tuning for 100+ GNU Radio SDR waveform scripts to precise dBm targets via amplifier control, eliminating manual tuning and saving significant tester time.

Control Dashboard – Built an ASP.NET Core + Angular interface for RF switch matrices, PTU, and GPS/compass integration with log window, health/status displays, and point-to-target azimuth/elevation with magnetic declination correction.

TRx Control Wrapper – Created Java API wrappers for a VIAVI Tx/Rx system to enable control from other software, adding WebSocket/STOMP telemetry and SSH diagnostics.

Security & Compliance – Achieved DISA STIG compliance on RHEL systems by reviewing findings in STIG Viewer, performing assessments, and applying remediations through automated Bash scripts.

Field Support – Deployed, tested, and troubleshot integrated EW/RF systems on-site.

Core Tech: C#, C++, Python, Bash, Angular, ASP.NET Core, Qt, GNU Radio, Protobuf, ArcGIS Runtime SDK, MIL-STD-1553 (ALTA, DDC), Telnet, WebSockets/STOMP, SSH, Serilog, RHEL, Windows, TAK
positions.insights: Skills: C#, MVC, & Web API · Qt · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Risk Management Framework (RMF)

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
•Participated in an Agile Environment, daily stand-ups, sprints, and Scrum meetings.
•Specifically worked on a project for my team which involved creating a responsive dashboard that displayed valuable information/data via widgets that could render on any device.
•Gained hands on experience in JQuery, C#, TypeScript, CSS, SASS, Javascript, VS, Jenkins CI, Subversion, MVC, Object-Oriented Programming
•Implemented a swipeable alert bar(similar to IPhone or Android) using SwipeJS that allowed touch or mouse drag events.
•Code always tested and 100% code coverage always achieved.
•Created a website for a specific team using SharePoint 2013, SharePoint Designer 2013, and InfoPath2013

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
•        Implementing ASP.NET Technologies in an Agile environment. 
•	Experienced in designing, developing, implementing, maintaining and enhancing web based business solutions.
•	Significant understanding of the Microsoft .NET Framework with significant programming experience in C#.NET, ASP.NET, and MVC.
•	Used CSS for GUI design and also used JavaScript for client side validation
•	Participated in an Agile Environment, daily stand-ups, sprints, and Scrum meetings
•	Experience with Object Oriented Programming Techniques.
•	Working experience on the Backend using MS SQL
•	Highly skilled at front-end engineering using Object-Oriented JavaScript, various JavaScript libraries and micro frameworks (jQuery, Angular, Bootstrap), HTML and CSS
•	Adapted to constantly changing technologies and challenges posed by evolving technologies.
•	Outstanding interpersonal written and verbal communication skills
•	Ability to work with multiple groups within the company
•	Created dozens of fully functional front-end, back-end, and full stack Apps
•	Completed multiple projects using:
o	C#, HTML 5, Canvas, CSS 3, JQuery, JavaScript
o	AJAX, JSON, SQL Server, IIS, Angular
o	ASP.NET MVC, Razor, Entity Framework, LinQ, Visual Studio, Team Foundation Server
o	Object Oriented Design concepts , CRUD operations
